title: COVID-19 Endoscopy Survey
brief_summary: A questionnaire containing some critical questions about practice inside GI endoscopy units in different countries will be distributed via emails. Responses will be collected in an online platform and data will be analyzed to reveal the effect of SARS-CoV-2 pandemic on different aspects of GI endoscopy practice in the studied countries.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* physicians working in endoscopy units worldwide

Exclusion Criteria:

* physicians not working in endoscopy units worldwide
study_population: \- physicians working and practicing in gastrointestinal endoscopy units worldwide
